Yes. **My first recommendation would be Lukas Snear, LPC, NCC, of Azimuth OCD and Anxiety** in Prosper, Texas. He focuses exclusively on OCD, offers telehealth throughout Texas, is trained through the International OCD Foundation’s BTTI program, and treats a broad range of OCD presentations with ERP. His listing reports that he accepts Aetna, BCBS, Cigna, Curative, and UnitedHealthcare; private-pay sessions are listed at $250. ([iocdf.org](https://iocdf.org/providers/snear-lukas/?utm_source=openai))

Other strong Texas telehealth options:

- **Dr. Chad Brandt, PhD** — Houston-based licensed psychologist specializing in OCD and ERP; offers telehealth in Texas and other PSYPACT states. ([drchadbrandt.com](https://www.drchadbrandt.com/?utm_source=openai))
- **Jen Herz, LCSW** — Austin therapist specializing in OCD/ERP; offers telehealth across Texas and works with adolescents and adults. ([herzpsychotherapy.com](https://herzpsychotherapy.com/?utm_source=openai))
- **Loni Itah, MA, LPC** — Austin-area OCD specialist offering telehealth; treats adults and teens age 15+, including perinatal OCD, scrupulosity, relationship OCD, and co-occurring ADHD/autism traits. ([iocdf.org](https://iocdf.org/providers/itah-loni/?utm_source=openai))
- **Hollie Spinn, LCSW** — online-only ERP specialist offering telehealth in Texas; reports a $165 session fee and accepting several insurance plans. ([iocdf.org](https://iocdf.org/providers/spinn-hollie-j/?utm_source=openai))
- **Kimberly Wilson, LPC/LMFT** — Plano-based provider offering virtual OCD care for adults, children, and families, including ERP and family interventions. ([iocdf.org](https://iocdf.org/providers/wilson-kimberly/?utm_source=openai))

When contacting someone, ask:

1. “What percentage of your practice is OCD treatment?”
2. “Do you provide structured ERP, including between-session exposures?”
3. “Are you licensed to provide therapy while I am physically located in Texas?”
4. “Do you accept my insurance, and what is the out-of-network rate?”
5. “Do you treat my particular OCD theme or co-occurring condition?”

Availability and insurance participation can change, so confirm those details directly. The IOCDF notes that its provider listings are self-reported, although licensure and BTTI completion are verified. ([iocdf.org](https://iocdf.org/providers/snear-lukas/?utm_source=openai))
